title: A customer question about Creating an Account

question.author: member_104
question.body: I need a short answer about creating an account. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Getting Started documentation says: You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from the billing portal. Create a CloudBox account with your email address and a password of at least 12 characters, then verify your email address to activate it. Personal accounts can optionally enable two-factor authentication in the Security panel; organization accounts are required to enroll in 2FA by their administrator's policy (mandatory for all orgs since CloudBox 2.1). That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
